author: h. r. chandler
title: Shelby County invites bids for concrete pipe pickup with May 21 deadline
text:
Shelby County announced on May 8 that it is seeking sealed bids for the purchase and pickup of concrete pipe. Bids will be accepted at the office of the Chief Financial Officer, located in the Shelby County Administration Building at 200 West College Street, Room 125, Columbiana, Alabama, until 2:00 p.m. on May 21. At that time, all submitted bids will be opened publicly and read.
The invitation to bid specifies that after its issuance, all informal communications with the county regarding this solicitation must cease. Any questions about bid specifications should be directed to Mary Horton by email at mhorton@shelbyal.com no later than noon on May 13. Written responses to these questions will be posted on the eBid Portal by close of business on May 15.
Bidders are instructed to rely only upon written guidance or responses provided through this process. The county stated that failure to comply with this communication provision may result in disqualification from consideration.
This bidding process offers vendors an opportunity to supply materials needed by Shelby County while ensuring transparency and adherence to established procedures.
